Bingley had a lot of faith in Darcy's opinion and thought very highly of his judgment. When it came to intelligence, Darcy was the superior one. Bingley was no dummy, but Darcy was exceptionally smart. At the same time, Darcy was haughty, reserved, and had very high standards, and his polished manners didn't make him very approachable. In that sense, his friend had a big advantage. Bingley was guaranteed to make a good impression wherever he went, while Darcy constantly rubbed people the wrong way.
